mechanism.who_is_forced_or_underreacts: The FORCED participant is the correcting filer: a Form 4/A exists only because something in the original Form-4 was wrong and had to be repaired - the amendment is a compelled disclosure repair, and the filer's remaining freedom is largely WHEN to repair it. A LATE amendment (long d) means the misstated insider-transaction record survived in the public record for d days before correction: either slow internal detection or evasion-until-forced, both adverse-control signals. The LATE/wrong participant is the attention-limited outside reader who prices the 4/A print as a clerical footnote: reconstructing the pair linkage requires the (issuerCik, rptOwnerCik, periodOfReport) match against the originals index - no standard data product carries it, and the pinned substrate itself did not contain the 4/A docs until this cycle - so the correction print arrives without its original and the market under-reacts to what the DELAY reveals: the longer the misstatement lived, the more stale the record everyone priced, and the more the post-amendment window drifts.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: The correction-repair literature (restatements as the severe tail of the same class) documents that markets react to corrections as a function of how much and how long the original record was wrong, and that correction events are systematically under-processed relative to that content because they arrive as re-issues rather than headlines (Palmrose-Richardson-Scholz 2004; Dechow-Sloan-Sweeney 1996 for the detection-lag structure - cited as lineage of the correction axis ONLY; this lane measures the insider-filing correction class that literature never prices, on document-level acceptance stamps). If the delay axis carries incremental content, issuers whose corrections arrive LATE under-perform issuers whose corrections arrive PROMPTLY over the post-amendment window after band costs - and the ranking input is pure timestamp arithmetic on a relation no dead observable could express.
mechanism.information_distinctness_vs_dead_observa: (a) vs the V11 cadence-latency form (cluster #13, SFV11-A5-H1): that observable was a per-entity FILING-CADENCE characteristic over successive filings, and its own shuffled-chain control REPRODUCED the anchor at 1.2042x - a distributional artifact of exposure shape; P1's observable is the WITHIN-PAIR timestamp delta between two specific linked documents, a relation that did not exist on the V11 substrate (0 4/A docs) and cannot be generated by any filing-count regularity. (b) vs the V12 chain-structure forms (SFV12-A4-P1/P2, dead 0.5822/0.2085 vs the V11 cadence-latency shadow): chain depth/shape GEOMETRY across an amendment sequence; P1 uses one lag scalar per pair and no depth/shape statistic - same document class, disclosed as the NEAREST DEAD RELATIVE, and the v11_cadence_latency_form + v12_chain_structure_form vetoes are measured at D2 fail-closed. (c) vs filing_event_reaction_shadow: no event-reaction conditioning anywhere - the exposure never reads a price series. (d) vs the V13 insider twins (0.232/0.2402 vs vol_level) and the ng1 10b5-1 kills (goodwill_bloat -0.3547/-0.384): no flow direction, no declared-plan flag, no flagged-session cadence, no plan-share composition - the only insider content P1 consumes is WHEN the correction landed relative to its own original. entry_exit_fills.window_convention: STRICT_NEXT_BAR declared ex-ante (the default; NO SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE variant anywhere): qualifying amendment acceptance session s -> entry fill at the first allowed session close strictly after s; a fill references only names with a bar at that session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing).
entry_exit_fills.hold_and_rearm: hold H = 21 trading days from the LAST qualifying pair-acceptance session (each new qualifying pair re-arms the exit - repeated late corrections extend the state); exits at the H-th close after the latest re-arm; fold boundaries force flat; substrate-end windows exit-at-last-close.
entry_exit_fills.book_form: daily-marked event book: at each decision close the book holds the set of in-state entities; within each frozen sector tag with >= 6 eligible ranked names, SHORT the top tercile of amendlag (late corrections: long-lived misstatements, disclosure-evasion signal) and LONG the bottom tercile (prompt corrections: routine repairs), equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg per active decision else the book abstains that date (counted); gross <= 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9; tercile ties at a boundary join the LOWER (long-side) tercile - deterministic and conservative.
entry_exit_fills.costs_measured_referenced: band model A/B/C 10/15/25 bps per side, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, applied to BOOKED PnL (kernel_band_cost_v9.py verbatim; L-I3 fail-closed); exits of held names via resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing).
